title.narrative: AU Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child
AU Charter on the Rights and Welfare of the Child

description.narrative: This support is related to a proposal submitted by Plan Sweden, together with Save the Children Sweden and coalition of NGOs active in Africa. The main objective of the support is to improve the lives of children in Africa as per the provisions of ACRWC by enhancing the capacity of AU Organs, AU Committee of Experts on ACRWC and of CSOs to engage with the AUC and its organs on child rights issues.
